title: Prediction: one shared parameter set survives every arena

statements.text: A parameter derived by one action in every arena (gravitational-wave ringdowns, horizon-scale interferometry, supernova neutrinos, optical clocks, equivalence-principle tests, cosmology and pulsar timing) is recovered compatibly in each arena separately and survives independent data releases, with no arena borrowing significance from another.
statements.falsification_criteria: An arena prefers a response incompatible with the claimed shared parameter (a model split), or a compulsory effect is excluded where the model declares it unavoidable.

prediction.resolution_criterion: Independent pre-registered inferences in each arena recover the same shared parameter within the registered tolerance, and a later independent data release confirms it.

sources.quote: A parameter may be shared only when one action or constitutive law derives its appearance in every participating map.
A recovered branch is persistent when the same parameter authority, forward map and compatibility survive independent data releases, instruments or analysis teams within the registered tolerance.
